references.title: Ela: In Silhouette
references.credit: Adolphus Opara / Adunni Olorisha Trust and Adunni Osun Foundation
references.observation: The two sharply bent arms have unequal heights and forked tips. The neck rises separately between them below the asymmetrical hood.

references.title: Ẹ̀là: Sculpture at Ẹbu Ìyá Mọòpó
references.credit: Adunni Olorisha Trust and Adunni Osun Foundation
references.observation: The oblique view shows two feet angled above the ground, a narrow open slit in the lower figure, paired chest relief and the long weathered shaft.

references.title: Ẹ̀là sculpture, 1985
references.observation: The frontal photograph shows narrow Y-shaped shoulders, unequal elbows, a separate upright neck and an asymmetrical hood.

references.title: Osun-Osogbo Sacred Grove, 14 March 2020
references.observation: The carved chest and projecting toes identify the front. Camera metadata gives the approximate angle and position.

map.note: The geotagged March 2020 photograph and the published site map locate Ẹ̀là west of Ìyá Mọòpó. The photographed front faces about 118° true. The projected footing is 10.7 m from map marker 16. The phone reports 30 m horizontal uncertainty. The exact footing and bearing are approximate. The site fit keeps the original roads, landcover and water.

photoFit.limitations: Estimated range from the 8.4 m authored height and photo framing. The phone reports 30 m horizontal position uncertainty in the grove. The nearly frontal view constrains the front to southeast. Exact footing and rotation remain approximate.

limitations: The Trust documents a height above 8 m. The modeled height is 8.4 m. Front and oblique photos guide its proportions. Side depth, fine relief and footing extent are estimated.
